where: Section 1, Chennai water-meter example and figure
problem: The term 'cloud broker' is used for the MQTT/message broker. In standard cloud computing, a cloud broker is a different role: an entity that intermediates between cloud providers and consumers. The same sentence also makes the broker keep months of history and run billing, but a message broker only ingests messages; storage and billing are separate services. A student can confuse the two meanings.
fix: Say: 'A message broker running in the cloud receives the readings. A time-series store keeps months of history, and a billing service runs the month-end jobs.' Label the figure node 'Message broker (MQTT)'.

problem: Hybrid cloud is defined as joining public and private resources only. The standard definition is a composition of two or more distinct cloud infrastructures, which may include a community cloud. The narrow wording can cost marks.
fix: A hybrid cloud joins two or more deployment models, usually public and private, under common management.

problem: 'The cloud also adds servers when traffic rises' can make students picture physical servers. In cloud computing, capacity is added as virtual servers or instances; the provider may add physical hosts invisibly.
fix: The cloud also adds virtual servers or instances when traffic rises and removes them when it falls.
